name: Ray of Sickness
summary: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 Poison damage; the target is Poisoned until the end of your next turn.
text: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit it takes 2d8 Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.
